P7652.corridor_notes: 163.com (Guangxi Daily/网易订阅 republication, dated 2020-09-26) reports first welding on the 陆川天然气支线管道工程 (Luchuan gas branch pipeline project), built by 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 (Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co.): '陆川支线起自玉林市福绵区沙田阀室，止于陆川县温泉镇陆川分输站，全长27km，其中福绵境内18km，陆川境内9km。中间设有大路塘阀室一座，设计压力为4MPa，设计年输量为0.85亿m3，项目总投资11657万元。' (The Luchuan branch starts at the Shatian valve station in Fumian District, Yulin, and ends at the Luchuan distribution station in Wenquan Town, Luchuan County; total length 27km -- 18km within Fumian, 9km within Luchuan -- with one intermediate valve station, Dalutang (大路塘阀室); design pressure 4MPa; design annual capacity 0.85x10^8 m3; total investment 116.57 million RMB.) This closely matches GEM's recorded LengthMergedKm=28 (27km as-designed, consistent within rounding), and corroborates the prior-pass finding (pilot_digest) that the true physical start is Shatian Town/Fumian District, not 'Bobai' as currently recorded in GEM's StartLocation -- 'Bobai' appears to reflect that this branch continues on from the separately-built Bobai gas branch, not the literal start point. A second gigeps.com e-procurement notice (18592.htm, a 2023-era design-service tender for a secondary high-pressure connector) independently names '陆川分输站' as a real, physically built anchor point, connecting onward to a third-party 'Longhao natural gas station' (龙豪天然气场站) -- confirming the Luchuan distribution station is an operating hub, not a phantom sheet entry. No exact station-level coordinates (only place names) were found for either 沙田阀室 or 陆川分输站 despite targeted searches; both endpoints are geocoded at town centroid (Shatian Town / Wenquan Town) as the finest independently sourced level.
P7652.researcher_notes: Builds on the prior-pass (pilot_digest) finding that identified the government approval doc (桂发改能源〔2019〕480号, approved 2019-05-15) as the primary source but found it unreachable (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn ConnectTimeout, confirmed again this pass -- also no Wayback Machine snapshot exists for that URL, checked via the wayback availability API). This pass found and directly verified (raw curl of the served HTML, not just an AI summary) a genuine, independent, reachable news republication (163.com/网易订阅, dated 2020-09-26, reporting the pipeline's first-weld milestone) that states the exact same start/end route description in its own words, naming both endpoint stations and the Fumian/Luchuan county split (18km + 9km = 27km). This URL passes url_verifier with content tokens '沙田'/'陆川分输站'/'温泉镇' present. A WebSearch snippet of the (unreachable) primary gxzf.gov.cn approval document independently corroborates the same start/end wording (Shatian sub-station -> Luchuan distribution station west of Datian Chong/大田冲 in Wenquan Town) but was not used as a citation since I could not independently fetch and verify it live (per standing rule, no fabricated/unverifiable refs) -- it is directional confirmation only, not a citation. Diameter (D273.1mm per the gxzf.gov.cn search snippet) remains unfilled/unsourced from a verifiable URL, consistent with the prior pass's finding -- out of scope for this route-creation task, flagged only for awareness.
